slides.heading: Review with your physio or GP if
items: Can't lift arm after a fall

caption:
Momo's bands feel easy now, but reaching overhead is still hard. Many people hit this point in shoulder rehab, where the shoulder needs more varied, progressive load for everyday life.

Reformer springs can support part of your arm's weight or add resistance in small steps. Rows, arm work and side-lying exercises help the shoulder blade and rotator cuff share the load. If you've had surgery or are seeing a physio, sessions follow their plan.

A shoulder that won't lift after a fall, pins and needles down the arm or building night pain is worth reviewing first. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio works alongside our physios. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
